title: Estimates of Expenditure of Singapore for the Financial Year 1 April 2020 to 31 March 2021
what_it_is: Estimates of Expenditure of Singapore for the Financial Year 1 April 2020 to 31 March 2021

sections.label: Estimates totals and amendments
sections.summary: The totals for each Head of Expenditure in the Main and Development Estimates for FY 2020 are taken from pages 6 and 7 of the Command Paper, with 531 amendments submitted and guillotine times set under Standing Order 92(7)(a).

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: For convenience, I shall take the totals for each Head of Expenditure in the Main and Development Estimates as they appear in the last columns of the schedules of estimated expenditure under the Main and Development Estimate outlays for financial year (FY) 2020 on pages 6 and 7 respectively of the Command Paper.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: A total of 531 amendments to the Estimates of Expenditure have been submitted for this year.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: The "guillotine times" to the discussion of the Heads of Expenditure under Standing Order 92(7)(a) have taken into consideration the earlier commencement time of a Sitting, the reduction of Question Time and the extension of sitting times of the Committee of Supply for each allotted day.
